name: xebit-vision
description: MediaPipe in the browser at 2 fps, result JSON over a WebRTC data channel

scripts.build: npm run build:worker && vite build && tsc src/client/index.ts --ignoreConfig --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --rootDir src --outDir dist/types --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --strict --skipLibCheck
scripts.e2e: npm run assets && npm run build:worker && vitest run test/e2e.test.ts
